fusions.name: Sharpened With the Teeth
fusions.desc: Hurls a sharpened stick that deals 14 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Thornbranch Swipe
fusions.desc: Swings a thorned branch across a 3-tile cone ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to everything in it. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Brute Finesse
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: No Wasted Muscle
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 8 stamina. Once every 5 seconds.
